title: Coast Guard Rescues 3 People, Dog North of Oahu
description: The three person crew of the Brandi Anne and their dog exit an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew at Air Station Barbers Point, Hawaii, Aug. 9, 2015. Following a distress call on VHF-FM channel 16 the Dolphin crew arrived on scene 41 miles northeast of Oahu’s North Shore and hoisted the three people and their dog safely into the helicopter before returning to Air Station Barbers Point. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Barbers Point.
keywords: Coast Guard rescue, MH-65, Coast Guard, dolphin
pass_reason: All tarmac footage of survivors and the dog leaving the helicopter at Barbers Point; no rescue on camera.
